# Wardlight

> Wardlight is a city builder and tower defence for iPhone and iPad by Stefan Draskovits, an independent developer in Vienna, Austria. You are the Wardlight, the flame at the heart of a village at the edge of an endless Mist: by day you build only where your light reaches, by night thousands of Blight crawl out of the Mist toward whatever burns brightest. Release date: 3 December 2026 (App Store). Free to play with one in-app purchase (Full Game, €4.99 / $4.99), no ads, no account, fully offline.

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS and iPadOS 26 or later. Not on Android, PC or consoles.
- Genre: city builder, tower defence, roguelite runs. Single player.
- A run: twelve in-game nights, each with an untimed day before it, about forty minutes. The game saves at every dawn.
- Scale: up to 2,500 Blight alive at once, simulated on the device twenty times a second and drawn by a custom Metal renderer.
- Six lands, unlocked one after another by holding the one before: Witchwood, Fenlands, Highlands, Ashwood, Stonehold, Rosegarth. Each has its own Blight, seasons and a boss on night twelve.
- Every building has its own talent tree, bought with Knowledge earned at night; each tree ends in a keystone.
- At its fourth level the Wardlight takes an Attunement: Ember (fire, free), Verdant (spreading rot) or Dawn (chain lightning that stuns). Verdant and Dawn come with the Full Game purchase.
- Between runs, the Memory keeps upgrades; it stays open after the third run with the Full Game purchase.
- Difficulty: a Darkness ladder per land adds hardships and pays more Echoes.
- Story: an old dwarf lampwright who would rather be retired, against Lady Vaelith, who spreads the Mist so no light falls on the scar on her cheek.
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Russian, Turkish, Dutch.
- Privacy: anonymous play data only (TelemetryDeck), can be turned off in Settings → Apps → Wardlight.
- Age rating: 9+.
